about: Shree TNB Polymers manufactures HDPE, PP/PPH and double wall corrugated pipes, drip irrigation and sprinkler systems, solid industrial sheets and Wellpack corrugated sheets under the Noble, Tirupati and Balaji (Wellpack) brands. It operates two plants at Silvassa (Dadra and Nagar Haveli) with 24,000 MT per annum installed capacity and sells through 325+ dealers, mainly in Maharashtra, Gujarat and Delhi. Revenue was about Rs 198 crore in FY26.
headquarters: Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

objects.purpose: Capital expenditure for purchase of machinery
Capital expenditure for purchase and installation of solar panel/roof top
Part finance construction/installation of Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) structure for new manufacturing facility

promoters.background: Eleven individual promoters across the Thosani, Raura, Bhalodi and Patel families, with 7 to 40+ years of experience in polymer, procurement, sales and production. Company took over four partnership firms in 2007; Bhalodi and Patel joined in 2017.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers were 29.97% of FY26 revenue (top customer about 11%); the risk text separately quotes 61.28% for FY26 which conflicts with the customer table. Top 10 suppliers were 61.28% of FY26 purchases. Over 99% of revenue is domestic; Maharashtra is about 50%.

litigation_note: Against the company: 10 direct tax and 4 GST matters totalling Rs 1.42 crore. By the company: 6 civil cases of Rs 4.04 crore. One civil case against promoters involves Rs 14.68 crore. Contingent liabilities only Rs 0.10 crore.
strengths: Over 25 years in polymer pipes with established Noble, Tirupati and Wellpack brands.
Diversified range: HDPE, PP, DWC pipes, drip irrigation, industrial sheets and packaging sheets.
Dealer network of 325+ across several states; BIS and ISO certified products.
Revenue rebounded 12.8% in FY26 and PAT grew 23.6% to Rs 7.13 crore.
EBITDA margin improved from 7.32% in FY24 to 9.69% in FY26.
Two Silvassa plants with 24,000 MT capacity and a leased 10,111 sq m site for expansion.
ROCE of 16.02% and RoNW of 13.69% in FY26.

risks.title: High debt and thin margins
risks.detail: Total borrowings were Rs 44.56 crore at Mar-26 (debt/equity about 0.80) against PAT of Rs 7.13 crore and a PAT margin of 3.60%; finance cost was Rs 6.04 crore.

risks.title: Revenue volatility and customer concentration
risks.detail: Revenue fell from Rs 207.86 crore in FY24 to Rs 175.65 crore in FY25. Top 10 customers were 29.97% of FY26 revenue and the top customer about 11%. Risk text quotes 61.28%, which conflicts.

risks.title: Raw material price and supplier dependence
risks.detail: Top 10 suppliers were 61.28% of FY26 purchases, with no long-term supply contracts; polymer prices are volatile.

risks.title: Litigation against promoters and company
risks.detail: One civil case against promoters involves Rs 14.68 crore; 14 tax cases against the company total Rs 1.42 crore.

risks.title: Delays in statutory dues and ROC filings
risks.detail: Instances of late payment of income tax, GST and provident fund in FY24 to FY26, plus many delayed ROC filings, some up to 3,002 days late; some share transfer forms are untraceable.

risks.title: Large working capital and weak cash conversion
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was Rs 4.34 crore in FY25 against PAT of Rs 5.77 crore; short-term borrowings of Rs 35.43 crore fund a business with a 1.22 current ratio.

risks.title: Related party dealings
risks.detail: Purchases and sales with promoter-linked firms such as Prime Industries (Rs 1.06 crore purchases in FY26) plus salaries to many promoter relatives.

risks.title: Expansion execution risk and unfunded objects
risks.detail: Rs 15.86 crore of machinery is mostly unordered, quoted in USD and imported from China; currency moves can raise cost and the plant is on leased land.

notes: Standalone, restated, FY24 to FY26, source figures in lakhs converted to Rs crore. Price band, issue size in Rs and P/E are blank in the RHP. Balance sheet and cash flow tables were garbled and reconstructed; net worth, EBITDA, PAT, ROCE, RoNW, OCF taken from reported KPI table; cash is cash and cash equivalents. Debt/equity is computed (total borrowings / net worth) as not reported. EBITDA as reported does not tie to PBT plus interest plus depreciation less other income. Reservation percentages are of net issue (anchor is part of QIB); a 3,00,000 share market maker portion is excluded. Fresh issue only, 60,00,000 shares. No stub period.
